usedFor: Pitchit builds your pitches and Asana tracks the work, so “When a new pitch is created” runs “Create Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new pitch is created” in Pitchit, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each new pitch gets its own Asana project, with owner and dates, ready for the team.

watchOut: “When a lead's insights are updated” runs on every update, so “Create Task or Subtask” can repeat for one lead.
